My friend Jack is very kind. The bus stop is not far from my home. I like my life very much. I borrow books from the library every week.
Eva and Jack are in the same class. Jack often helps me with art. Eva goes to the museum on Friday. What's more, my watch shows the wrong date.
Eva drinks water every morning. The night market is big and clean. Jack likes chicken too.
